title: fagara hiemalis
intro: Fagara hiemalis, commonly known as Szechuan pepper, is a plant species in the Rutaceae family. It is a deciduous shrub native to China, used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Fagara hiemalis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and protect against infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
